purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom vision law profiles that depend on adventure object SID or category allowlists. This is static object classification evidence only; it does not prove fog reveal mutation, owned-structure radius, neutral threat data, enemy hero position, or authorize gameplay mutation.
requiredStaticEvidence: exact object SID allowlist or explicit object category allowlist
companion predicate list for reveal radius, threat, corpse, elemental, or existing-class semantics
requiredRuntimeProof: object owner/side correlation proof where owned structure is used

forbiddenSubstitutes: army elemental family without object mapping
conflux.elemental-site-reveal.notes: Conflux vision allowlist must use exact object SID/category evidence plus explicit elemental-family mapping.

forbiddenSubstitutes: any ocean or ship travel mechanic
neutral camp value inferred from display text
cove.structure-scout-treasure-banks.notes: Cove vision allowlist must use exact treasure/bank/camp object classification and must not introduce ocean travel mechanics.

inferno.existing-gate-site-reveal.notes: Inferno vision allowlist must use existing map object classes only and must not fabricate teleport mechanics.

necropolis.corpse-site-undead-reveal.notes: Necropolis vision allowlist must use logical corpse/battle-site data or exact object allowlists, not visual corpse inference.

forbiddenSubstitutes: stack weakness inferred from display color
stronghold.weak-neutral-stack-scouting.notes: Stronghold vision allowlist must use native neutral strength/intention data and must not parse localized threat text.

tower.structure-artifact-regional-reveal.notes: Tower vision allowlist must use exact artifact SID/category classification and structure-driven region context.
